name: vado
description: Valkey or Redis on Cloudflare Durable Objects: the real servers compiled to wasm, sharded behind a Worker

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c apps/dashboard/dist/server/wrangler.json

VALKEY_PASSWORD.description: The password clients send with `AUTH <database> <password>`. It also opens WebSocket access (`/ws`). Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Zero Trust team domain, like `https://<team>.cloudflareaccess.com`. See [Sign in](https://github.com/vaishnav-mk/vado#sign-in).

ACCESS_AUD.description: The **Application Audience (AUD) tag** of the Access application on `/signin`.
